voiceNarration.introPromptSsml: <speak><prosody rate="150wpm" pitch="default">Let us explore <emphasis level="moderate">Place value</emphasis>! Watch closely, then try it with your finger.</prosody></speak>

Your brain is getting super fast and accurate!

fluencySprintGame.title: Place value — Fluency Blitz
fluencySprintGame.mechanics: Fast-paced bridge-builder with 6.5s pacemaker and 70/20/10 spiral interleaving.

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Place value
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Place value] Subtract across zeros: 400 - 167 = ?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Unbundle 4 hundreds into 3 hundreds, 9 tens, and 10 ones: (300-100) + (90-60) + (10-7) = 233.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Place value] What is 706 written in expanded form?
sampleQuestions.explanation: 706 has 7 hundreds (700), 0 tens (0), and 6 ones (6): 700 + 6.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Place value] Mentally find 100 more and 10 less than 582.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Adding 100 increases the hundreds digit (5 -> 6: 682); subtracting 10 decreases the tens digit (8 -> 7: 572).

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Tiling area to model Distributive Property a × (b + c), decomposing rectilinear figures, finding unknown side lengths from perimeter, exhibiting rectangles with same perimeter/different area or same area/different perimeter, drawing non-subcategory quadrilaterals & expressing partitioned shape areas as unit fractions 1/b (3.MD.7c-d, 3.MD.8, 3.G.1-2)] A rectangle is partitioned into 4 equal shares and 3 shares are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
sampleQuestions.explanation: The denominator (4) tells total equal parts in the whole; the numerator (3) tells shaded parts: 3/4.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Tiling area to model Distributive Property a × (b + c), decomposing rectilinear figures, finding unknown side lengths from perimeter, exhibiting rectangles with same perimeter/different area or same area/different perimeter, drawing non-subcategory quadrilaterals & expressing partitioned shape areas as unit fractions 1/b (3.MD.7c-d, 3.MD.8, 3.G.1-2)] Which fraction is equivalent to 1/2 on the number line?
sampleQuestions.explanation: 2/4 lands on the exact same midpoint between 0 and 1 as 1/2.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Tiling area to model Distributive Property a × (b + c), decomposing rectilinear figures, finding unknown side lengths from perimeter, exhibiting rectangles with same perimeter/different area or same area/different perimeter, drawing non-subcategory quadrilaterals & expressing partitioned shape areas as unit fractions 1/b (3.MD.7c-d, 3.MD.8, 3.G.1-2)] Compare two fractions of the same whole: 2/6 ___ 2/3.
sampleQuestions.explanation: When numerators are the same (2 parts), sixths are smaller pieces than thirds because the whole is cut into more shares.

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Customary units of measurement
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Customary units of measurement] Count the mixed coins: 2 quarters, 1 dime, and 3 pennies. What is the total?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Start with quarters: 25¢, 50¢. Add 1 dime: 60¢. Add 3 pennies: 61¢, 62¢, 63¢.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Customary units of measurement] Which coin shows Abraham Lincoln on the front (heads) and is worth 1¢?
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Penny
sampleQuestions.explanation: The copper penny features Abraham Lincoln and equals 1 cent (1¢).

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Customary units of measurement] An apple costs 45¢. You pay with 2 quarters (50¢). How much change do you get?
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: 5¢ (1 nickel)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Count up from 45¢ to 50¢: 45 + 5 = 50, so your change is 5¢.

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Short and long vowels
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Short and long vowels] Tap the 3 sound boxes as you segment the word SHIP: /sh/ - /i/ - /p/. Which digraph makes the first sound?
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: sh
sampleQuestions.explanation: The letters s and h team up to make one continuous sound: /sh/.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Short and long vowels] Add Silent-e to the closed-syllable word TAP. What new long-vowel word is formed?
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: tape (long a)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Silent-e at the end jumps over one consonant and makes the vowel say its long name: /t/ - /ā/ - /p/.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Short and long vowels] Break the multisyllabic word CABLE into its two syllables and identify the second syllable type.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: ca | ble (Open + Consonant-le)
sampleQuestions.explanation: ble is a Consonant-le syllable, leaving ca as an open syllable with a long a sound.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Main idea] Read: Leo zipped up his heavy coat, pulled on wool mittens, and watched his breath turn into white puffs. What can you INFER about the setting?
choices: It is a freezing winter day outside.
Leo is going swimming at the beach.
It is a hot summer afternoon.
Leo is inside a warm kitchen.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: It is a freezing winter day outside.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Clues: heavy coat + wool mittens + breath turning into white puffs = freezing cold weather.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Main idea] Which text structure does an article use when it explains why soil erodes and then describes three ways farmers stop erosion?
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Problem and Solution
sampleQuestions.explanation: The passage introduces an environmental problem (soil erosion) followed by actionable solutions.

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Shades of meaning
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Shades of meaning] Tap the 3 sound boxes as you segment the word SHIP: /sh/ - /i/ - /p/. Which digraph makes the first sound?
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: sh
sampleQuestions.explanation: The letters s and h team up to make one continuous sound: /sh/.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Shades of meaning] Add Silent-e to the closed-syllable word TAP. What new long-vowel word is formed?
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: tape (long a)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Silent-e at the end jumps over one consonant and makes the vowel say its long name: /t/ - /ā/ - /p/.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Shades of meaning] Break the multisyllabic word CABLE into its two syllables and identify the second syllable type.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: ca | ble (Open + Consonant-le)
sampleQuestions.explanation: ble is a Consonant-le syllable, leaving ca as an open syllable with a long a sound.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Sentences, fragments, and run-ons] Combine the two simple sentences into a compound sentence: The rain fell. + We played inside.
choices: The rain fell, so we played inside.
The rain fell we played inside.
The rain, fell so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: The rain fell, so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Use a comma followed by the coordinating conjunction so to show cause and effect between two complete thoughts.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Sentences, fragments, and run-ons] The Latin root PORT means to carry and the prefix TRANS- means across. What does TRANSPORT mean?
choices: To carry across from one place to another
To write a story about life
To look closely at small things
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: To carry across from one place to another
sampleQuestions.explanation: Trans- (across) + port (carry) = to carry goods or people across distances.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Sentences, fragments, and run-ons] Choose the correct homophone: The dogs wagged _____ tails when _____ owner arrived.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: their / their
sampleQuestions.explanation: Their is a possessive pronoun showing ownership (their tails, their owner).

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Materials
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Materials] When liquid water is heated in a pot and turns into water vapor (gas), what phase change has occurred?
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Evaporation
sampleQuestions.explanation: Adding thermal energy causes liquid water particles to speed up and escape as gas (evaporation).

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Materials] You bring the North pole of Magnet A close to the North pole of Magnet B. What happens?
choices: They repel (push away from) each other
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: They repel (push away from) each other
sampleQuestions.explanation: Like magnetic poles (N-N or S-S) repel each other; opposite poles (N-S) attract.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Materials] In a forest food chain (Sunlight -> Oak Tree -> Squirrel -> Hawk), what role does the Oak Tree play?
choices: Producer (makes its own food using sunlight)
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Producer (makes its own food using sunlight)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Plants are producers because they use sunlight, water, and air to make food via photosynthesis.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Chronology and causation] On a map with a compass rose, if you walk from the school toward the top of the map, which cardinal direction are you traveling?
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: North
sampleQuestions.explanation: On a standard compass rose, North points toward the top, South toward the bottom, East to the right, and West to the left.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Chronology and causation] If a freeze destroys most of the orange crop (low supply) while many shoppers still want orange juice (high demand), what happens?
choices: A shortage occurs and prices tend to rise
A surplus occurs and prices drop
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: A shortage occurs and prices tend to rise
sampleQuestions.explanation: When quantity demanded is greater than quantity supplied, there is a shortage.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Chronology and causation] Why does the US Constitution divide the federal government into three branches (Legislative, Executive, Judicial)?
choices: To provide checks and balances so no single branch has all the power
So each branch can rule a different continent
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: To provide checks and balances so no single branch has all the power
sampleQuestions.explanation: Checks and balances ensure Congress makes laws, the President carries them out, and the Courts review them.
